overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Multi-Sector Income ETF (TMSF) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on broad credit fixed income. TMSF actively invests across the full global fixed income universe spanning multiple credit sectors, countries and currencies TMSF was launched on Nov 19, 2025 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
